scope: artifacts/diagnostics/round82/gemm only (disjoint from root R82 isolation driver)
kind: FP16 operand -> FP32 accumulator GEMM custom-kernel prototype; source only
why: Round80 measured extra Half bias rounding in native biased Linear and Half partial-output rounding in TP row GEMMs;framework npu_grouped_matmul refused output_dtype=float32 with 161002.This establishes that FP32 accumulation is the hardware-native mode and is expressible in a custom kernel.

decisive_evidence.interpretation: FP16 operands with FP32 destination is the only float matmul combination on these parts;there is no half-output float combination.Any half output is expressed as FP32 accumulate plus an explicit cast.The framework 161002 rejection was an op-interface restriction,not a hardware limitation.

additional_evidence.fixpipe_fp32_destination: sdk/te_tik_api_cube_tik_cube_api.py fixpipe docstring: dst may be float16/float32/int32,src is float32/int32 -> L0C FP32 can leave the cube as FP32
additional_evidence.bias_is_910b_gated_fp32_in_l1: sdk/te_tik_api_cube_cube_common.py check_params_bias: requires is_910b_soc(),bias.scope L1,bias 1-D length N,and bias.dtype==dst.dtype -> for an FP32 L0C destination the bias must be float32,added in FP32
additional_evidence.device_soc_matches: ASCEND_910B="Ascend910B" equals the runtime-reported device soc,so the bias gate passes on this host
additional_evidence.dsl_equivalent: tbe/dsl/api.py matmul exposes dst_dtype float16/float32 and tensor_bias used to init L0C;gemm_compute keeps FP32 without cast when dst_dtype=float32 and casts once otherwise

prototype.why_micro: TIK high-level matmul requires whole A and B in L1 (1 MiB);the real H3 geometry (M=2043,K=5120) cannot be a single tile
prototype.compile_soc_reason: bias is gated on is_910b_soc() which reads the compile soc;forcing Ascend910A (as earlier kernel work did to escape a wrong 310B default) would silently disable the bias operand
